name: TRON
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: DWallet Labs discovered a zero-day vulnerability in TRON multi-signature accounts that put more than $500 million in digital assets at risk. What about the threshold and number of signers defined in the account. The bug has now been disclosed and fixed, so no user assets are now at risk.
